audit.why: 4/10 FAVOURED tracks 55.85% over 2179 games; Brand has no dash and loses every close fight, Fizz owns all seven rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-3 spike credited Nimble Fighter with tenacity.
audit.why: Riot's text: Fizz's passive is unit-walking plus flat damage reduction. No tenacity.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text now cites unit-walking; the mid-game text now cites the flat damage reduction against Blaze ticks.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sear was called 'his CC' with no cooldown and without the ablaze condition being tied to real numbers; wants.foe[0] claimed Pillar of Flame roots.
audit.why: Sear (Q) stuns ONLY when the target is ablaze, 8/7.5/7/6.5/6; the ablaze comes from Pillar of Flame (10/9.5/9/8.5/8) or Conflagration (13/12/11/10/9). Nothing in Brand's kit roots.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field carries the real numbers and the ablaze chain; wants.foe[0] now reads Pillar into Sear for the stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: mid-game text claimed Fizz's ultimate detonates Blaze.
audit.why: Blaze becomes unstable and detonates when Brand's own spells take it to max stacks; nothing in Chum the Waters' text triggers it.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the shark's knockup landing the string.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Playful / Trickster like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sear (Q): 8s at rank 1 down to 6s — it only stuns while Blaze is on you, so the stun always follows Pillar of Flame or Conflagration. - Pillar of Flame (W) is 10s at rank 1, his one wave answer. - Playful/Trickster is 16s at rank 1 — never spend it first.

edits.before: Q through him, W bleed, walk out through the wave — the fish phases in and out before his answer finds a target.
edits.after: Hop the Sear that follows his Blaze stack, then land while Conflagration sits on its 13-second rank-1 cooldown.

edits.before: Hopping in first against a held CC — the pole spent as an entrance is the whole kit spent as a coin flip.
edits.after: A pole spent on a fake Sear leaves you sixteen seconds of standing still inside his Pillar of Flame.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Brand wins by stacking Blaze and then stunning with Sear, with Pyroclasm bouncing you down from 750 range.

edits.before: Carry through deletions — shark, string, pole, repeat; one carry per fight is the contract and the pole notarizes it.
edits.after: Carry by killing Brand himself — no dash, no escape, so once Sear is spent his 8-second gap is your whole all-in.

edits.before: Fish the strings and respect one spell — his CC is the lane; everything else is water.
edits.after: Fish short strings and respect Sear — it only stuns once Blaze is on you, so dodge his W first.

edits.before: Brand needs to land Sear or a full Pillar-Sear-Conflagration combo to threaten you, but Nimble Fighter tenacity and your E-hop dodge his skillshots easily enough that you can jump in on cooldown and punish.
edits.after: Brand needs to land Sear or a full Pillar-Sear-Conflagration combo to threaten you, but Nimble Fighter's unit-walking and your E-hop dodge his skillshots easily enough that you can jump in on cooldown and punish.

edits.before: From 6 onward your all-in is close to a death sentence for Brand if he's caught without Flash — your ultimate detonates Blaze and finishes the combo before he can kite with Sear resets, and Nimble Fighter shrugs off his slow/stun procs enough to keep closing distance.
edits.after: From 6 onward your all-in is close to a death sentence for Brand if he's caught without Flash — the shark's knockup lands your full string before he can answer with Sear, and Nimble Fighter's flat damage reduction blunts his Blaze ticks enough to keep closing distance.

edits.before: Ult removes his only outs (Sear kite, Flash) from the equation entirely
edits.after: Ult knocks him up out of his Sear window and removes Flash from the equation

edits.before: Land Pillar to root you before you can jump, since that's his only real peel
edits.after: Land Pillar of Flame into Sear for the stun, since that chain is his only real peel

notes: missingInteractions offered 'Brand can deny your mobility with Pillar of Flame (W)' via the terrain flag. That flag is a tooltip-parsing misfire — Riot's text for Pillar of Flame creates no terrain and applies no grounding, only damage. Not asserted anywhere. Level chart left as-is: all seven rows Fizz on both layers, consistent with 55.85% over 2179 games.
